retired_reason: Superseded by cdhw_contribution.py. Two CDHW tests in this pipeline disagreed on the sign (+0.0116 here vs -0.0079 in the ablation), both single-seed on NeuralCQR, and neither carried dependence-aware inference. Across five model families and three seeds the mean dR2 ranges from -0.0057 to +0.0017 with no year-level test significant; within LightGBM alone the per-seed dR2 spans -0.0095 to +0.0114. The CDHW block is used as a pre-specified stratification variable, not as a predictor.
